m20.text: The Siege of the Bone Spire, chronicled by Krinnea, saw knights and angels fight the necromancer's horde, and at sunrise an angel appeared over the charnel fields, bringing a surge of new hope.
The knights charged forward on wings of wind and the horde roared in helpless rage, and with a single word the necromancer's legion was unmade.
With each knight that rode out from the bone-white keep the queen's soldiers lost courage, and when a knight struggled to stand, his squire took up his blade and held the foe back.
